engine.name: Market Core V2.0-Alpha
engine.status: 39.2.17 UI/Math Core host-width behavior preserved; workspace preference persistence corrected in 39.2.18

notes: 39.2.18 is built directly from 39.2.17 and preserves its validated Math Core host-width correction and Administrator window behavior.
Current workspace state (agent_crypto_erith_ia_workspace_state_v2) is now the authoritative source for operator preferences on reload; last_valid_graph is used only when no current workspace exists.
A stale last_valid_graph can no longer overwrite Solo/Top 3/Top 5/Hausses 5/Baisses 5/Volumes 5, period, selected assets or chart view options during F5 restoration.
Workspace preferences are saved even while a previous ready graph is temporarily displayed during a new selection/period load; graph incoherence only prevents promotion to last_valid_graph.
Scanner transactions can no longer block saving the current workspace; they still cannot promote an in-flight graph to last_valid_graph.
The historical silent conversion of an invalid Scanner workspace preset into rank-5 is removed from atlasWorkspaceRead; a saved preset is not rewritten into another preset during read.
No chart renderer, historical acquisition, Market, Atlas, NØX, Aerith, Memory Intelligence, Math Core, Window Manager, Metal CSS or A/B/C slot storage behavior is modified by this build.
